name: lib/atomic
description: Declares atomic values and memory ordering operations.
readme: Declares atomic values and memory ordering operations.
Import this module with use atomic.

files.content:
-- Declares atomic values and memory ordering operations.
public define Atom as opaque.
public use "atomic" function create(value unsigned) giving failable pointer to Atom.
public use "atomic" function release(value pointer to Atom) giving nothing.
public use "atomic" function load(value pointer to Atom, order text) giving failable unsigned.
public use "atomic" function store(value pointer to Atom, number unsigned, order text) giving failable nothing.
public use "atomic" function add(value pointer to Atom, number unsigned, order text) giving failable unsigned.
public use "atomic" function swap(value pointer to Atom, number unsigned, order text) giving failable unsigned.
public use "atomic" function replace(value pointer to Atom, expected unsigned, number unsigned, order text) giving failable boolean.
